events.title: Too Deep to Quit - Update 1.1.0 is coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey fellow adventurers!We're participating in Steam Next Fest! and we're bringing a major update with us.We've been listening closely to your feedback, and Update 1.1.0 brings a major overhaul to Too Deep to Quit. We've reworked core gameplay systems, redesigned parts of the experience, introduced new items, and made significant improvements across the board.Thank you for all your feedback and support! Your comments help us understand what needs to change and how we can make the game better.Alre
